title: What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
abstract: arXiv:2610.37465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training

translated_title: 《什么得以延续？语言模型各版本发布间的预训练信息披露》
translated_abstract: 理解语言模型如何进行预训练，需要关于其数据、处理流程和计算资源的信息。然而，后续发布的模型是否保留或扩展了先前的信息披露，目前仍不清楚。我们基于文档，使用2025年基础模型透明度指数（FMTI）中的24个预训练相关指标，对来自17个模型系列的41个模型条目进行了审计。我们考察了总体得分和指标概况，追踪了十个系列中24组相邻版本比较之间的信息披露增益、损失和保留情况。结果显示：11组比较中得分下降，6组上升，7组保持不变，总体上共有38项指标损失和28项指标增益。总分稳定甚至提高的情况可能掩盖具体损失：OLMo-2和OLMo-3尽管有三项增益和三项损失，却获得相同的总分；Llama-3.1相比Llama-2总体有所提升，却在两个数据相关标准上失去了得分。此外，语料库构成和训练方面的披露差距依然存在。
tldr: 该研究对17个模型系列41个模型的预训练信息披露进行了基于文档的审计，发现后续版本发布并不保证透明度延续或提升，总分的稳定或改善可能掩盖具体指标上的信息披露损失。
